description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing scheduled posts in Mattermost, including creating, fetching, updating, and deleting scheduled posts via API calls.

methods.name: createSchedulePost
methods.description: Creates a new scheduled post via API and dispatches a Redux action upon success.

methods.name: fetchTeamScheduledPosts
methods.description: Fetches scheduled posts for a team, handles errors including forced logout, and dispatches corresponding Redux actions.

methods.name: updateScheduledPost
methods.description: Updates an existing scheduled post via API and dispatches a Redux action upon success.

methods.name: deleteScheduledPost
methods.description: Deletes a scheduled post via API and dispatches a Redux action upon success.
